content: {"episode_id":"ep-05029","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for missing prior authorization based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias in the setting of known atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and guide further management."}
